"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If Congress makes no changes to the Budget Control Act of 2011, automatic cuts of $55 billion each in annual defense and “discretionary domestic” spending will begin.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The resulting drop in aggregate demand from a combination of spending cuts and increases in taxes would almost definitely cause a double-dip recession.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
